BETA Close X Ninety One PLC has repurchased a total of 562,869 ordinary shares between July 20 and July 24, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The purchases were executed by J.P. Morgan Securities plc, with prices ranging from 209.2000 GBp to 220.0000 GBp per share, and a volume-weighted average price of 217.2581 GBp on July 20, 216.9626 GBp on July 21, and 210.5107 GBp on July 24. These repurchased shares are intended for cancellation, and following these transactions, the company holds no shares in treasury, with 662,420,367 ordinary shares currently in issue. Morgan Securities plc. Morgan Securities plc by the Company on 3 June 2026 as announced on 3 June 2026. The Company intends to cancel the purchased shares.
